hook.name: DeviationFeeHook
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee for a native ETH/wstETH pool, driven by the deviation between the pool price and the Chainlink wstETH/stETH rate. Base fee 0.01% inside a 35 bps deadband; swaps that correct the deviation pay base + 50% of the excess, capped at 0.5%; from 100 bps both directions pay. Falls back to the base fee if the feed is stale or fails. afterInitialize + beforeSwap only; no deltas, hookData, storage, admin or upgradeability.
